description: Local file & code bridge: grant the REMOTE BioClaw web UI (chat/beta.bioclaw.tech ONLY) the fs + shell permissions it needs to act as a full local file/code agent — read, write, edit, create/delete/move files, and run shell commands on the user's machine. Every MODIFYING action (write/edit/mkdir/delete/move/exec) is gated on the web-UI side by the 3-tier permission model (读取/读写/完全) + a per-action confirmation dialog, so a broad fs+shell grant here is safe: nothing runs without the user's tier + approval. Scoped via remote.urls to the BioClaw origins only — Tauri APIs are never exposed to arbitrary origins. fs scope is intentionally broad ($HOME/** + drive roots) because the agent operates on user-chosen absolute paths.
